description: Ground floor rear extension 6 metres deep, maximum height 3.50 metres, 2.95 metres high to the eaves
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials used on the external surfaces of the development shall match those used in the building to which it is attached in terms of style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Condition : 2 - All openable parts of any side windows in the extension shall be more than 1.7 metres above finished floor level and permanently retained as such. Any side windows shall be in obscured glazing and permanently retained as such. Once built, no further side windows shall be installed.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Cover Letter], [ASB558-03], Received: 25/08/2020, [ASB588-02], [Unnumbered Existing and Proposed Elevations], Received: 14/10/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
